name: Guelph / Mississauga
description: A Guelph–Highway 401–Mississauga corridor formerly reaching Cooksville, later centered on Square One and extended to Kipling.

timeline.event: The federal/provincial launch release announced University of Guelph–Aberfoyle–Square One–Cooksville service for 3 September. The route 29 number is independently documented by 2008.
Additional weekday trips increased the University of Guelph–Cooksville route toward hourly service.
The original table retains Cooksville GO as the Mississauga endpoint.
The table runs Guelph Central–University–Aberfoyle–Square One with Regional Road 25 and Transitway timepoints.
Route 29 extended to Renforth/Kipling; a university–Square One Friday/Sunday express pilot was announced.
Branch 29A added an express University of Guelph–Square One connection.

sources.title: Transport Canada: GO Transit expands bus service to the University of Guelph, 29 August 2007
Transit Toronto: GO Transit changes start April 26, published 22 April 2008
GO table 29, printed effective 5 September 2009 (filename dated 2 January 2010)
GO Guelph / Mississauga table 29, effective 5 January 2019
Metrolinx announces increased weekday service across GO network, 26 August 2021
Metrolinx: GO bus schedule changes coming Aug. 31, 2024

gaps: The launch release describes the corridor without a route number; the number 29 is independently documented by the April 2008 service-change notice.
Dates when Cooksville was removed and Guelph Central added need intervening timetables.
